name: operator-ops
description: Thirteen skills for running an agent setup for a month: a chief of staff, cost reports, dependency audits, release notes, a scoped PR review, meeting prep, inbox triage, secret rotation, MCP and approval audits, a spam trap, a setup scorecard and a skill curator. Ten are adapted from OnlyTerp's Hermes Optimization Guide (MIT); every one reports, and nothing sends, merges or deletes without a tap.
